events.label: Baseline liver function tests normal (ALT 28, AST 24)
events.evidence_text: His baseline liver function tests were normal, with ALT 28 U/L and AST 24 U/L

events.label: Drug A started (oral antifungal)
events.evidence_text: was started on Drug A, an oral antifungal agent, on 3 January for onychomycosis

events.label: Drug B started (macrolide antibiotic)
events.evidence_text: On 8 January he was prescribed Drug B, a macrolide antibiotic

events.label: Community-acquired pneumonia documented on chest radiograph
events.evidence_text: a chest radiograph showed a right lower lobe infiltrate consistent with community-acquired pneumonia

events.label: Malaise, nausea and dark urine
events.evidence_text: On 18 January the patient presented with malaise, nausea and dark urine

events.label: ALT 642, AST 518, bilirubin 3.1 mg/dL
events.evidence_text: Laboratory testing showed ALT 642 U/L, AST 518 U/L, alkaline phosphatase 180 U/L and total bilirubin 3.1 mg/dL

events.label: Ultrasound: no biliary obstruction
events.evidence_text: Abdominal ultrasound demonstrated a normal biliary tree without obstruction

events.label: Drug A discontinued
events.evidence_text: Drug A was discontinued on 20 January

events.label: Drug B continued to complete a ten-day course
events.evidence_text: Drug B was continued to complete a ten-day course

events.label: Fever resolved and pneumonia improved
events.evidence_text: The patient's fever resolved and the pneumonia improved over the following week

events.label: Liver enzymes normalised (ALT 31 U/L)
events.evidence_text: Liver enzymes declined gradually and had normalised by 10 February, with ALT 31 U/L
